Kogniti AgroPrint 75 GSM A4 Sustainable Copier Paper (500 Sheets)
descriptor.short_desc: Eco-engineered multipurpose 75 GSM A4 copier paper manufactured using agricultural crop residue pulp.
descriptor.long_desc: Breakthrough sustainable paper manufactured from agricultural residue such as wheat straw, sugarcane bagasse, and paddy stalks. Eliminates stubble burning and protects forest ecosystems.

descriptor.name: Kogniti AgroPrint 80 GSM A4 Premium Copier Paper (500 Sheets)
descriptor.short_desc: High-density 80 GSM A4 agricultural residue paper with 98% ISO brightness.
descriptor.long_desc: Engineered for boardrooms, law firms, and high-impact presentations. Ultra-smooth surface prevents feathering.

descriptor.name: Kogniti AgroPrint A4 Carton Pack (5 Reams / 2,500 Sheets)
descriptor.short_desc: Standard office master carton holding 5 shrink-wrapped reams of 75 GSM sustainable paper.
descriptor.long_desc: Master carton packaging engineered for quick handling and institutional storage in corporate mailrooms.

descriptor.name: Kogniti EcoSpiral A5 Professional Notebook (160 Pages)
descriptor.short_desc: Executive wire-bound A5 notebook with 100% post-consumer recycled covers.
descriptor.long_desc: Twin-loop black metal wire-bound notebook. Ideal for daily notes, project logs, and training workshops.

descriptor.name: Kogniti Multi-Subject B5 Campus Notebook (300 Pages)
descriptor.short_desc: B5 5-subject notebook with color-coded dividers made from recycled board.
descriptor.long_desc: Designed for university students and multi-project corporate teams.

descriptor.name: Kogniti Heritage Hardbound Executive Journal (192 Pages)
descriptor.short_desc: Hardbound luxury journal with bookmark ribbon, elastic band, and back pocket.
descriptor.long_desc: Crafted for leadership meetings, strategic journaling, and corporate milestones.

descriptor.name: Kogniti KraftDesk Modular Desktop Organizer Set
descriptor.short_desc: Plastic-free modular 4-piece desk organizer set for modern workspaces.
descriptor.long_desc: Includes pen stand, document tray, sticky notes cube, and card holder.

descriptor.name: Kogniti PureStem Bamboo Rollerball Pen (Pack of 10)
descriptor.short_desc: Sustainable bamboo rollerball pens with laser-engravable natural barrels.
descriptor.long_desc: Smooth 0.7mm blue gel refill, balanced weight, and zero single-use plastic barrel.

descriptor.name: Kogniti FileMaster Expandable Kraft Document Folder (Pack of 10)
descriptor.short_desc: Expandable 2-inch gusset document wallet holding up to 300 A4 sheets.
descriptor.long_desc: Reinforced edges and natural cotton ribbon tie closure for compliance and records.

descriptor.name: Kogniti Artisan Heavyweight A4 Art Sketchbook (120 Pages, 140 GSM)
descriptor.short_desc: Acid-free 140 GSM artist sketchbook with cold-pressed natural texture.
descriptor.long_desc: Micro-perforated sheets allow clean tearing without damaging binding.

descriptor.name: Kogniti Executive GreenWelcome Eco Hamper Box
descriptor.short_desc: Comprehensive corporate welcome kit in debossed magnetic-latch kraft box.
descriptor.long_desc: Includes journal, bamboo pen, desk calendar, plantable seed coaster, notebook, sticker pack.

descriptor.name: Kogniti Institutional Bulk Pallet: 75 GSM Agro Copier Paper (40 Cartons / 200 Reams)
descriptor.short_desc: Industrial wooden pallet wrapped in weather-proof stretch film with 100,000 sheets.
descriptor.long_desc: Delivered directly via hydraulic liftgate trucks. Dedicated transport insurance and batch quality certificate included.
